LEGIBILITY = how readable a trace appears; INTERPRETABILITY = the trace revealing the decision mechanism. ACTUAL step importance = 'advantage' (change in expected reward from including a step, via MC rollouts / causal ablation); JUDGED importance = an LLM judge or fine-tuned step critic reading the text. The gap is substantial - capable LLMs beat prevalence baselines but fall WELL SHORT of a noise ceiling; step importance is 'only partially recoverable from the text'. Challenges PRMs and LLM-as-judge.
